story_forms.label: Howard Adventure
story_forms.summary: Sword-and-sorcery adventure focused on violent survival and treachery.

quarters.title: Opening Menace
quarters.description: Open with danger, desire, and momentum.

components.title: Hook with Menace
components.description: Open with immediate threat or unnerving momentum.
components.guidance_prompt: Open with violent motion: ambush, raid, duel, storm, or bloodied discovery.

components.title: Hero Desire
components.description: Clarify what the protagonist wants right now.
components.guidance_prompt: What does the hero want now: treasure, vengeance, rescue, escape, or grim survival?

components.title: Initial Trouble
components.description: Introduce first obstacle that blocks straightforward progress.
components.guidance_prompt: What immediate force blocks the hero and raises bodily risk?

components.title: Hint of Deeper Menace
components.description: Signal that the visible threat is only surface-level.
components.guidance_prompt: What sign suggests ancient sorcery or treachery behind the first conflict?

quarters.title: Deepening Trouble
quarters.description: Attempts backfire as stakes and danger rise.

components.title: First Attempt
components.description: Show the protagonist taking concrete action.
components.guidance_prompt: Show a bold action through blade, stealth, or raw force.

components.title: First Complication
components.description: Complication worsens the cost of action.
components.guidance_prompt: How does the hero's move trigger worse danger or opposition?

components.title: Clue or Pattern
components.description: Reveal evidence that reframes the threat.
components.guidance_prompt: What clue ties the conflict to cursed ruins, cults, relics, or old bloodlines?

components.title: Rising Stakes
components.description: Raise personal and external consequences.
components.guidance_prompt: What escalates from a fight to a struggle for survival and consequence?

quarters.title: Trap and Terrible Revelation
quarters.description: Plans fail, betrayal strikes, and hidden truth emerges.

components.title: Reversal
components.description: Turn the apparent advantage into sudden danger.
components.guidance_prompt: Where does apparent advantage snap into near-defeat?

components.title: Betrayal or False Safety
components.description: Trust collapses or calm proves deceptive.
components.guidance_prompt: Who betrays the hero, or what shelter becomes a trap?

components.title: Terrible Revelation
components.description: Expose the deeper truth behind the menace.
components.guidance_prompt: What ancient truth makes the visible danger only the edge of something older and worse?

components.title: Deathtrap or Contact
components.description: Force direct confrontation with lethal danger.
components.guidance_prompt: Place the hero in a brutal trial with monster, sorcerer, or doomed chamber.

quarters.title: Payoff and Final Sting
quarters.description: Resolve conflict with a costly outcome and strong final note.

components.title: Final Confrontation
components.description: Deliver decisive clash with central threat.
components.guidance_prompt: How does the hero force a decisive end through risk and violence?

components.title: Cost of Survival
components.description: Name what is lost, scarred, or sacrificed.
components.guidance_prompt: What does survival cost in blood, allies, innocence, or future peace?

components.title: Resolution
components.description: Show immediate aftermath and practical outcome.
components.guidance_prompt: Show who escapes, what is destroyed, and what immediate order is restored.

components.title: Final Sting
components.description: Leave an ominous or ironic final image.
components.guidance_prompt: End with irony, omen, or surviving trace of menace.
